settings.heading: From Blueprint to “Sold”: The Complete Visual Lifecycle for Home Builders
settings.text: We partner with leading builders to accelerate sales velocity through 3D renderings, virtual staging and immersive marketing assets. From pre-sale to final close, we bring your vision to life.

settings.name: Your end-to-end visual partner
settings.text: Pre-construction: photorealistic 3D renderings that sell the dream before you break ground. Mid-construction: floor plans and virtual tours that keep buyers engaged during the build. Final sale: virtual staging for spec homes that shows lifestyle, scale and luxury without the overhead.

settings.heading: How builders and brokerages use Bella

settings.title: Highland Homes (Texas): scaling consistency across communities
settings.text: The challenge: one of Texas’s largest private builders needed a high volume of assets that stayed consistent across many lots and floor plans. The solution: Bella built a high-volume rendering pipeline, delivering consistent exterior elevations and interior vignettes so Highland Homes could market new communities months before construction began. The result: a unified digital presence across its Texas markets and more pre-construction leads.

settings.title: Olivia Clarke Homes: boutique luxury and brand storytelling
settings.text: The challenge: to stand apart from big-box builders, Olivia Clarke Homes needed visuals that communicated craftsmanship, custom finishes and a modern-meets-classic look. The solution: bespoke interior renderings with a heavy focus on texture and lighting, so the digital experience matched the physical quality of the homes. The result: 100% sell-through of featured developments before project completion, fuelled by high-engagement social media assets.

settings.title: Brown Harris Stevens (NYC): luxury real estate staging
settings.text: The challenge: in New York, empty luxury units can feel cold. BHS needed to show the scale and lifestyle of premium Manhattan properties without the cost of physical staging. The solution: our designers turned vacant units into designer-curated living spaces tailored to the New York buyer. The result: fewer days on market and more clicks on listing portals like StreetEasy and Zillow.

settings.title: Pacesetter Homes: interactive sales tools
settings.text: The challenge: helping buyers picture their future home while choosing between structural options and upgrades. The solution: a suite of photorealistic renderings showing different finish levels, so buyers felt confident in their choices. The result: happier buyers and a smoother design-centre process.
